dataset: SYNTHETIC test scenarios planted on real Olist weekly data
method: Detection uses single-metric z-scores (threshold 2); attribution uses breakdown rank and share of change. The breakdown threshold (3) flags standalone anomalies when scanning.

scenarios.planted: health_beauty sales in SP fall 85% (orders, revenue, items, reviews, deliveries scaled).
scenarios.agent_should_say: health_beauty revenue fell sharply, concentrated in SP.

scenarios.planted: In RJ, late deliveries rise to 30% and the average review score falls 0.8 points; revenue unchanged.
scenarios.agent_should_say: Average review score fell in RJ while late deliveries rose there; this is an observed pattern, not an established cause.

scenarios.planted: MG volume falls 50% evenly across all categories, with no change in delivery rates.
scenarios.agent_should_say: MG revenue fell sharply across all categories with no delivery change; unexplained, needs analyst review.

scenarios.planted: Real data: the week of 2018-08-20 is incomplete (end of data collection). Nothing planted.
scenarios.agent_should_say: Numbers for this week are not final; no conclusions drawn.

scenarios.planted: The review-score query fails (WBR_SIMULATE_FAILURE=avg_review_score); other metrics succeed.
scenarios.agent_should_say: Review score unavailable this week; revenue and orders reported.

scenarios.planted: Corrupted row: PR reports more late orders than delivered orders (impossible).
scenarios.agent_should_say: PR delivery data failed validation this week and is excluded.

scenarios.planted: BA's row is missing from weekly_metrics for this week (data did not arrive).
scenarios.agent_should_say: BA data is missing this week; totals are not reported as a drop.

scenarios.planted: SC reports zero delivered orders this week, so late delivery % cannot be calculated.
scenarios.agent_should_say: SC late delivery rate cannot be calculated this week (no deliveries).

scenarios.planted: Nothing planted: the agent requests an unknown metric, a non-Monday, or a week outside the window.

verifier_test_cases.claim: Average review score fell in RJ because late deliveries rose.
verifier_test_cases.reason: Causal wording without causal evidence; the data shows association only.
The cited tool result reports about an 85% drop; 95% appears in no evidence.

verifier_test_cases.claim: Average review score was stable this week.
verifier_test_cases.reason: The review-score tool call failed; no evidence supports any review claim.
